scripts.prepackage: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const v=require('./manifest.json').version; const tags=execSync('git tag').toString().trim().split('\n'); if(tags.includes('v'+v)){console.error('\x1b[31mERROR: v'+v+' is already tagged. Bump the version in manifest.json before packaging.\x1b[0m'); process.exit(1);} else {console.log('\x1b[32mVersion check passed: v'+v+' is ready to package.\x1b[0m');}"
